question: Separate process guidance, runtime authorization, and transaction business invariants in AI-generated enterprise actions.

request.ids: 1..100 nonempty distinct string IDs; each length <= 100

invariants: only an authenticated approver can execute
every target must belong to the current tenant
every target must be submitted and created by a different user
all requested IDs must exist and be eligible, otherwise no row changes
duplicates, empty/oversized lists, unknown input fields and invalid types are rejected
client input cannot choose tenant, creator or role
overlapping concurrent batches cannot both approve the same submitted record
a failed overlapping batch leaves its exclusive records unchanged
manual_controls: row-policy-only commits one allowed target from a mixed-tenant request
affected-count check rolls the same request back

process_guidance.shared_semantics: All cells receive the same complete business requirements and time/tool budget.
process_guidance.added_process: Before coding, enumerate invariants and failure cases; after coding run visible tests and inspect the diff. No hidden Oracle content is exposed.

sampling.pilot: Use a small balanced queue to estimate task discrimination before scaling repetitions.
sampling.unit: One fresh generation for a task instance and cell; retries and repairs are separate attempts.
sampling.blocking: Match task instance and fixture seed across Go cells; randomize cell execution order.
sampling.confirmatory: Freeze tasks, hidden fixtures, scoring, budgets and sampling rule before a separate confirmatory cohort.
sampling.power: Choose confirmatory sample size from a declared detectable effect and pilot variance; ten repetitions alone do not establish significance.

execution_prerequisites: Implement and validate the new task Oracle outside candidate writable/readable access before model trials.
Prepare the same Go codebase/capabilities and fixture contract for all four Go cells.
Extend the driver with explicit cell, process-prompt hash and hidden-evaluator provenance.
Record CLI version, environment, global instruction/configuration effects and requested model; served snapshot remains unknown unless reported.
